name: Gentle Daily Shampoo-Fig & Neroli
description: The Gentle Daily Shampoo in Fig & Neroli is the brighter, more expressive option in the Ritual family. The fragrance leads with sun-warmed fig and lifts with neroli from bitter orange blossom — together they create something with a quality of southern European warmth. The base formula is identical to all Gentle Daily Shampoo variants: 99.5% Natural Origin Index per ISO 16128-2, probiotic preservation, coconut-derived surfactants, gentle enough for weekly bathing.

name: Refreshing Mist
shortDesc: Japanese yuzu and white musk for a light coat refresh.
description:
Key ingredients

Citrus Junos · White Musk Accord

How to use

Hold 25 cm from coat. Apply 3–5 sprays over back and flanks. Allow to settle and dry naturally. Use after Dry Foam or alone; can be used daily.

Safety

Formulated for dogs; not suitable for cats.

name: Dry Foam Shampoo
description:
Key ingredients

Acacia Dealbata · Dipteryx Odorata

How to use

Shake. Hold 20 cm from coat and spray evenly. Work through with hands or soft brush. Focus on odour-prone areas. Allow to dry. No rinsing.

Safety

Formulated for dogs; not suitable for cats.

name: Anti-Tick & Flea Spray
shortDesc: Vetiver root and cypress resin; designed for pre-walk protection.
description:
Key ingredients

Vetiveria Zizanoides · Cupressus Sempervirens

How to use

Shake well. Spray evenly from 15–20 cm, focusing on legs, belly and neck. Let dry completely. Use before walks in tick/flea-active environments.

Safety

Not suitable for cats. Avoid eyes, nose and mouth. Patch-test sensitive dogs. For established infestations, consult a vet.

name: Paw Cleaner
shortDesc: Cleans and soothes paw pads after walks. Spearmint & Sea Salt — cool, clean, and mild on skin.
description:
Key ingredients

Mentha Spicata · Maris Sal

How to use

Pump onto each paw or a damp cloth. Massage pads and between toes. Wipe with a clean damp cloth. No rinsing. Use after every walk.

Safety

Not suitable for cats. Formulated for dogs.
